$comment: Phase 9 multi-agent roster. Copy to config/agents.json to enable specialized agents. A task routes to an agent by its explicit `agent` id, its `role`, or its `capabilities` (see CONFIGURATION.md). With NO agents.json, every project runs on a single implicit agent wrapping its `driver` — exactly the pre-Phase-9 behavior. Each agent's `config` block is deep-merged over the project config at launch, so an agent can override engine settings (model, cli command, etc.) without a separate project.

agents.$comment: Example generic-CLI agents. The `cli` driver runs any command-line engine; set command/args/promptArg and (optionally) usageLimit/network regex patterns. These are TEMPLATES — enable only engines actually installed on this machine. Disabled by default so a stray copy never routes real work to a missing binary.
